title.narrative: INSPIRE ¿ Incubator Space for Promoting Information Right and Freedom of Expression

description.narrative: The Overall Objective of the project is to contribute to the enhancement of democracy and human rights in Sri Lanka. Its Specific Objective is to promote an increased understanding and respect of freedom of expression and information, by empowering a community of youth to creatively express and advocate for the focus areas of (i) gender-sensitive freedom of expression and (ii) ethical and socially responsible media expressions.
